d.ko: Stretcher Together is a cooperative 3D platformer for two players. You play as medics rescuing a patient after a fall. Jump, balance, and climb your way up—but don’t drop the patient, or you’ll have to go back down to retrieve them!
d.en: Stretcher Together is a cooperative 3D platformer for two players. You play as medics rescuing a patient after a fall. Jump, balance, and climb your way up—but don’t drop the patient, or you’ll have to go back down to retrieve them!
d.zh: 《担架拍档》是一款双人合作3D平台游戏。你们将扮演急救员，负责营救一名坠落的伤患。跳跃、保持平衡、向上攀登——但千万小心别让伤员掉落，否则你们得重新返回救援！
